|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Rebel Leadership (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image shown here both print this text.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “▲ an admiral or a non-Jedi general. OR Once per game, ▼ a war room. OR If your admiral or non-[Episode I] general is in battle, may add one battle destiny or prevent opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny (that destiny may not be canceled).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) has the same text with the ▲ and ▼ icons written out as words: “Take an admiral or a non-Jedi general into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Once per game, deploy a war room from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your admiral or non-[Episode I] general is in battle, may add one battle destiny or prevent opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny (that destiny may not be canceled).”.<ref name="cl-1230_109-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rebel Leadership (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; its slip carries the errata mark E) changed “(that destiny may not be canceled)” to “(their battle destiny draws may not be canceled)”: “▲ an admiral or a non-Jedi general. OR Once per game, ▼ a war room. OR If your admiral or non-[Episode I] general is in battle, may add one battle destiny or prevent opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny (their battle destiny draws may not be canceled).”.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
